title: Chain Dimension Scaling: Communication-Efficient Loop-Style Scaling for Industrial Short-Video Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2610.16415v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industrial recommendation rankers keep scaling in width and depth to billions of parameters, but this increasingly incurs costs in parameter growth, distributed communication overhead, and training inefficiency. We introduce \underline{C}hain \underline{D}imension \underline{S}caling (CDS), a scaling strategy orthogonal to width and depth. CDS repeatedly applies a single feature-interaction block with parameters shared across iterations, so the number of iterations (the chain length) becomes a new scaling dimension that adds no parameters. A lightweight intra-chain residual connection stabilizes optimization and improves quality. CDS enables two regimes. translated_title: 链式维度缩放：面向工业级短视频排序的通信高效循环式缩放方法
translated_abstract: 工业推荐排序模型在宽度和深度上不断扩展至数十亿参数，但这日益带来参数增长、分布式通信开销以及训练效率低下等成本问题。我们提出了链式维度缩放，这是一种与宽度和深度正交的缩放策略。CDS反复应用单个特征交互块，并在迭代之间共享参数，因此迭代次数（即链长度）成为一种不增加任何参数的全新缩放维度。轻量级的链内残差连接稳定了优化过程并提升了模型质量。CDS支持两种应用模式：在压缩模式下，具有较长链的浅层块能够以更少的参数和更快的训练速度匹配更深的基线模型；在质量缩放模式下，在固定参数预算下增加链长度可以带来一致的离线和在线收益，这表明链长度……
tldr: CDS提出一种与宽度和深度正交的链式缩放策略，通过参数共享的特征交互块循环堆叠，将链长度作为不增加参数的新缩放维度，显著降低分布式通信开销并提升训练效率与模型质量。
en_tdlr: Chain Dimension Scaling (CDS) introduces a new scaling dimension orthogonal to width and depth by repeatedly applying a parameter-shared feature-interaction block, enabling communication-efficient scaling of industrial recommendation rankers with no additional parameters, faster training, and consistent quality gains.
